_comment: GW2 item IDs to track on the Trading Post. Find an item's id on its wiki infobox (API ID field) or at https://www.gw2bltc.com. Items with a known crafting recipe (via /v2/recipes/search?output=<id>) get a Craft Cost/Profit column computed from live ingredient prices - see app/gw2_api.py. These five are just placeholder examples - swap in whatever you actually care about.
